newsitem.title: UK: NWE heating oil spread steady, diesel talked firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE heating oil spread steady, diesel talked firm.

text.p: NWE heating oil traded at a steady differential on Tuesday and low sulphur diesel was talked firm.
August IPE closed 75 cents firmer at $167.75 a tonne after a tightly rangebound session.
A 20,000 tonne cargo of German heating oil was traded at August IPE +$1.50 for August 1-15 arrival.
Russian heating oil was bid at level to August IPE and offered at up to $2 over. French FOD quality gas oil was notionally assessed at 50 cents to $1 over the screen.
The firmer Russian numbers were driven by demand for scarce 10,000 tonners. Most recent Ventspils sailings have been of larger vessels.
Low sulphur diesel was rumoured traded firm at August IPE +$4.50 for the first decade of August but details were not immediately available.
Second half August was assessed at September IPE +$4.25/4.75.
Heating oil barges were done at flat to the August screen and at 25 cents over. Business was slow. Diesel was offered at August IPE +$4.25 and bid at +$3.75.
